facts.text: Traditional undergraduate students must complete 180 chapel credits to graduate, or an average of 45 credits per year for transfer students.

sources.title: CCU Lifestyle Covenant
sources.quote: Students are required to obtain 180 chapel credits (or an average of 45 a year for transfer students) in order to graduate.

facts.text: All students are required to complete 180 hours of community service before graduation.

sources.title: CCU Lifestyle Covenant
sources.quote: To this end all students are required to complete 180 hours of community service before graduation.
